args.summary: Lending-ops' first loans extract for 2026-10-01 was cut off at 10 of 21 records, so ingest_loans failed and dbt_build and publish never ran, which left mart_delinquency stale. A corrected re-delivery (_r1) arrived later. I re-ran ingest_loans for 2026-10-01; it loaded the r1 file, and dbt_build and publish succeeded, so the mart now has 2026-10-01. The raw.payments volume spike comes from Keel CDC events being sent again after a connector restart, which the contract documents. stg_payments already removes these duplicates, so it is expected and needs no action. No code, config or escalation changes were needed.
